main.description: Forward-topology chunk reader. Takes an array of H3 cells + LOD (resolution) and returns the per-cell, per-label GeoJSON features intersecting each cell. Replaces XYZ tile pyramid with H3-indexed chunks. Server translates each cell → boundary polygon → bbox, unions the bounding boxes, queries vertex_spatial once, then routes features back to their owning cell by centroid. Design: 90-docs/260417-maps-forward-topology-raw-to-webgpu.md

h3Cells.description: H3 cell IDs (hex) at the requested LOD. All cells must share the same resolution.

labels.description: Graph node labels to fetch. Omit for default set (Place, Road, Railway, Coastline, River, AdminArea, Building, Mountain, Port, Airport, Station).

limit.description: Max features per label per cell (default 500, max 5000).

chunks.description: { [h3Cell]: { [label]: GeoJSON Feature[] } } — features grouped by owning H3 cell. Point features mapped by centroid; line/polygon mapped by geometry centroid.
